title: InsideEVs - 2025 Volvo EX40 rename (XC40 Recharge becomes EX40)
notes: Volvo US 2025 pricing release relayed: Twin Motor gets 82 kWh (from 78), DC peak 200 to 205 kW for both Single and Twin Motor. The article text says single-motor versions keep 78 kWh, which contradicts the 2024 US release (single already 82 kWh) and Green Car Reports.
